Impact of Sleep on Immune & Physical Health
Chronic sleep deficiency increases risks of cardiovascular disease,
obesity, and weakened immunity. Sleep Duration Recommendations: - Adults
aged 18-64 require 7 to 9 hours of sleep per night for optimal physical
and cognitive function.
